name: mark_bills_paid
description: Mark the selected confirmed unpaid bills as paid in the ledger. Use the 1-based row numbers from inspect_selected_bills. The user reviews the changes.

name: mark_bills_unpaid
description: Mark specified paid bills as unpaid again. Use 1-based selected row numbers. To undo the last recorded payment, use undo_last_payment.

name: undo_last_payment
description: Undo the last payment recorded by the app for this month. Specify the complete set of its currently selected 1-based rows.

name: void_bills
description: Void specified active bills. Use 1-based selected row numbers. By default only the specified rows change. If the user asks to void an entire installment series, pass one selected installment row and scope=installment.

name: restore_bill
description: Restore a selected voided bill using its 1-based row. By default only that row changes. For an explicitly requested whole installment series, use scope=installment.

name: confirm_estimate
description: Confirm a selected estimate on its original record. Its title, repayment month, remaining amount, total price and paid deposit can be corrected. All amounts are in cents. totalCents must equal depositCents plus amountCents. Changing only the deposit keeps the original total. Changing only the balance keeps the original deposit.

name: create_bill
description: Create a bill on an existing named platform. For single use amountCents; for installment use amountCents (per period) and installmentCount; for estimate use the total price totalCents and optional paid deposit depositCents. The user reviews the amount and month.

month.description: Repayment month or first installment month YYYY-MM; omit for the current chat month

name: create_platform
description: Create a repayment platform with the name supplied by the user.

name: update_budget
description: Update only the requested salary or warning settings in integer cents. Supply at least one of defaultSalaryCents, warningFloorCents or overrideSalaryCents. For a monthly override, month defaults to the month shown in chat. Null explicitly removes that month's override.

name: manage_reminder
description: Enable, disable, or permanently delete one existing scheduled reminder when explicitly asked. Use the exact subject or task number (#12) supplied in the current user message. For 'turn off' or 'stop reminding me', disable it. Only delete on an explicit request to remove it. The device matches locally and shows the task for review.

name: show_pet_popup
description: Show a pet pop-up inside the app now. Only include a subject if supplied by the user.

testOnly.description: Only for an explicit test. Show a test pop-up without creating a task.

name: send_pet_notification
description: Send a system notification from the pet now. Only include a subject if supplied by the user.

testOnly.description: Only for an explicit test. Send a test notification without creating a task.

name: schedule_pet_popup
description: Schedule an in-app pet pop-up. Use one of delaySeconds (one time), atLocal (one local date and time), or recurrence (daily, weekly, monthly, elapsed minute intervals, or once at a random minute in each daily window). Only include a subject if supplied by the user.

weekday.description: Weekly only: ISO weekday, Monday=1 to Sunday=7

dayOfMonth.description: Monthly only: months without this day are skipped

minutes.description: Interval only: elapsed minutes between reminders, including the first delay

startTime.description: Inclusive start of the daily random window, local HH:mm

endTime.description: Inclusive end, different from startTime. An earlier end time falls on the next day.

name: schedule_pet_notification
description: Schedule a system notification from the pet. Use one of delaySeconds (one time), atLocal (one local date and time), or recurrence (daily, weekly, monthly, elapsed minute intervals, or once at a random minute in each daily window). Only include a subject if supplied by the user.

weekday.description: Weekly only: ISO weekday, Monday=1 to Sunday=7

dayOfMonth.description: Monthly only: months without this day are skipped

minutes.description: Interval only: elapsed minutes between reminders, including the first delay

startTime.description: Inclusive start of the daily random window, local HH:mm

endTime.description: Inclusive end, different from startTime. An earlier end time falls on the next day.
